text: マチス　の　ようじん　ぶかさは　ぐんたいでも　ゆうめい　だったぜ！

structure.jp: マチス　の　ようじん　ぶかさは
ゆうめい　だったぜ！

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: Swapping the last い of a describing word for さ turns it into a thing: 'cautious' becomes 'cautiousness'. ようじん ぶかさ = 'cautiousness'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: で says where, and も adds 'too' or 'even'. ぐんたいでも = 'in the army too'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes the statement at the listener. ゆうめい だったぜ = 'was famous, I tell you'.
